question: Who among the following cricketers is NOT among the Wisden Five Cricketers of the Year named by the 2020 edition of the Wisden Almanack?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andre Russell.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Jofra Archer, Pat Cummins, Ellyse Perry, Simon Harmer, and Marnus Labschagne have been named the Wisden Five Cricketers of the Year by the 2020 edition of the Wisden Almanack. 

 
 
• **Hence Andre Russell is NOT among the Wisden Five Cricketers of the Year named by the 2020 edition of the Wisden Almanack.**
 
 
 
• Perry was named the Leading Woman Cricketer in the World, while Ben Stokes was named the Leading Cricketer in the World.
 
• Perry is the first foreign woman to win the award.
 
• The Wisden Cricketers’ Almanack, often labelled the ‘Bible of cricket’, Is an annual publication founded in 1864 by John Wisden.
